paper_metadata.title: Constrained Optimization via Quantum Zeno Dynamics

experiments.description: Numerical benchmark of QAOA with Zeno dynamics versus penalty-based constraint handling on constrained portfolio optimization instances with one budget-type inequality constraint and with an additional return constraint, across 4 to 10 assets.

hyperparameters.eta: fixed in numerics; chosen to ensure constant minimum in-constraint probability per layer
hyperparameters.penalty_factor_lambda: tuned extensively for baseline penalty method
hyperparameters.objective_rescaling: cost function rescaled so gradients w.r.t. beta and gamma are roughly same magnitude
hyperparameters.initial_parameter_search: large number of random initial points

algorithm.parameter_initialization: COBYLA initialized with a large number of random initial points; some experiments also use parameter transfer from eta = 1.6

problem_formulation.encoding_details: One binary variable per asset; portfolio represented by x in {0,1}^n
problem_formulation.objective_function: min_x in F q x^T Sigma x - mu^T x
problem_formulation.constraints_handling: Zeno dynamics via repeated projective measurements after mixer layers; baseline uses penalty terms
problem_formulation.problem_hamiltonian: C = sum_x f(x) |x><x|; mixer Hamiltonians B = sum_j x_j or B = |+><+|

problem_instance.description: Discrete mean-variance Markowitz portfolio optimization with either a single portfolio-size inequality constraint or two constraints (portfolio size and minimum expected return).

dataset_specification.description: Portfolio instances are described as benchmark problems; no ticker symbols or date range reported.

problem_instance.data_preprocessing_details: Objective rescaled for optimization stability; no further preprocessing reported.
problem_instance.evaluation_methodology: Exhaustive QAOA parameter optimization; results reported as approximation ratio r and in-constraint probability 1-delta across 14 instances

quantum_resources.num_qubits: 4 to 10 logical qubits for portfolio variables; additional auxiliary qubits for constraint checking depend on oracle implementation and are not fixed in numerics
quantum_resources.circuit_depth: p layers with repeated measurements; measurement count varies with beta and eta

implementation_details.classical_preprocessing: Penalty baselines tuned over lambda; QAOA parameters optimized with COBYLA from many random starts; cost rescaling used
implementation_details.classical_postprocessing: Approximation ratio and in-constraint probability computed from optimized quantum output

speedup_claims.factor: measurement overhead scales linearly with QAOA layers and at most quadratically with qubit count for common mixers; O(polylog(dim H)) in favorable cases
speedup_claims.conditions: fault-tolerant quantum processors; repeated projective measurements; common mixers such as B = sum_j x_j or B = |+><+|
speedup_claims.caveats: This is an efficiency/scaling claim for constraint enforcement, not a classical-vs-quantum speedup.

complexity_analysis.quantum_complexity: Number of measurements scales linearly with QAOA layers and at most quadratically with qubit count for common mixers; asymptotically O(polylog(dim H)) for constraint enforcement overhead

experiments.description: Numerical benchmark of Zeno-enhanced L-VQE on the same constrained portfolio optimization instances, with single and multiple constraints.

algorithm.variant: Layer variational quantum eigensolver with Zeno dynamics
algorithm.parameter_initialization: Large number of random initial points

problem_formulation.objective_function: min_x in F q x^T Sigma x - mu^T x
problem_formulation.constraints_handling: Repeated projective measurements after all parameterized gates; no penalty terms in the main Zeno method
problem_formulation.problem_hamiltonian: Observable M evaluated on the L-VQE state; portfolio cost Hamiltonian implied by the Markowitz objective

problem_instance.description: Discrete mean-variance Markowitz portfolio optimization with one or two constraints, evaluated on 4- to 10-asset instances.

dataset_specification.description: Benchmark portfolio instances; no public dataset name reported.

problem_instance.evaluation_methodology: Reported approximation ratio r and in-constraint probability 1-delta for each asset count and constraint setting

quantum_resources.num_qubits: 4 to 10 logical qubits for portfolio variables; auxiliary qubits for constraint oracles not separately enumerated
quantum_resources.circuit_depth: L = 1 with measurements inserted after parameterized gates

implementation_details.classical_preprocessing: Heuristic choice of N = 100 measurements; COBYLA optimization from random initial points
implementation_details.classical_postprocessing: Compute approximation ratio and in-constraint probability from optimized circuit output

speedup_claims.factor: measurement overhead scales efficiently; O(polylog(dim H)) in favorable cases
speedup_claims.conditions: general parameterized evolution with repeated projective measurements; favorable cases discussed in the paper
speedup_claims.caveats: No classical runtime comparison is provided; this is a scaling claim for the constraint-enforcement mechanism.

complexity_analysis.quantum_complexity: Measurement overhead scales efficiently; for general parameterized evolution, overhead is O(polylog(dim H)) in the favorable cases discussed

experiments.description: Hardware proof-of-concept QAOA with Zeno dynamics on a 4-asset portfolio problem with an equality constraint, comparing semiclassical QFT with QCL versus coherent QFT without QCL.

algorithm.variant: QAOA with Zeno dynamics on trapped-ion hardware
algorithm.parameter_initialization: QAOA parameters first optimized using a noiseless simulator

problem_formulation.encoding_details: 4 binary variables x1..x4 for the portfolio; equality constraint checked via Fourier-domain arithmetic
problem_formulation.objective_function: Portfolio cost from the 4-asset Markowitz instance used in numerics
problem_formulation.constraints_handling: Semiclassical QFT oracle with QCL and mid-circuit measurements; measure full register and reset auxiliary qubit to |+> after successful projection

problem_instance.description: Four-asset portfolio optimization with equality constraint 2x1 - x2 - x3 = 0.

dataset_specification.description: Same 4-asset benchmark portfolio instance as in the numerical section; no ticker/date details reported.

problem_instance.evaluation_methodology: 2000-shot hardware runs and noiseless simulation; in-constraint probability plotted versus number of measurements

quantum_resources.num_qubits: 5 qubits total with QCL oracle; 7 qubits total without QCL oracle
quantum_resources.circuit_depth: Two-qubit gate depth up to 148 without QCL and 122 with QCL at N = 15; measurements varied from 1 to 20
quantum_resources.gate_count_total: 165 without QCL at N = 15; 123 with QCL at N = 15

noise_model.noise_description: hardware noise on trapped-ion device; no explicit noise model

implementation_details.classical_preprocessing: Noiseless simulator used to optimize QAOA parameters before hardware execution
implementation_details.classical_postprocessing: Measure in-constraint probability and compare simulator versus hardware distributions

speedup_claims.caveats: Hardware proof-of-concept only; no classical baseline or speedup claim.

complexity_analysis.quantum_complexity: Hardware demonstration of repeated-measurement Zeno enforcement; no asymptotic runtime measured experimentally
